jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Deca Food Tech oy is a technology-driven company focused on innovation in the food industry. The organization combines software engineering with food technology to improve efficiency, quality, and sustainability in food production and related processes. Deca Food Tech oy values practical problem-solving, collaboration, and the use of modern tools to address real-world industry challenges. Team members are encouraged to learn continuously and contribute to impactful solutions that support both business goals and customer needs.
Role Description
The Software Engineer internship role at Deca Food Tech oy is an on-site position based in Helsinki. The intern will assist in designing, implementing, and testing software components that support the company’s food tech solutions. Daily tasks may include writing clean and maintainable code, working on back-end services, debugging and resolving issues, and collaborating with senior engineers on feature development. The intern will also participate in code reviews, documentation, and the integration of software modules into existing systems. This internship provides hands-on experience in a collaborative environment and exposure to industry-relevant tools and practices.
Qualifications

Foundational knowledge in Computer Science and Software Development, including understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software life cycle.
Practical skills in Programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), with experience in at least one common programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C#, or similar).
Basic experience or coursework in Back-End Web Development, such as working with APIs, databases, and server-side frameworks.
Ability to analyze problems, propose solutions, and write clear, efficient, and well-documented code.
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work in an on-site team environment in Helsinki.
Ongoing or completed studies in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Interest in the food tech domain and willingness to learn industry-specific tools and technologies.

jobs.title: Senior .NET & Angular Engineer IRC296850
jobs.description:
Description

Our client is the world’s leading provider of investment management systems. This is our new cloud-native product for client communications, that will boost client engagement. This product will be used by world’s leading asset managers to deliver financial information to their customers in a more innovative and engaging way consumed directly in their web browser from all over the world using either phone, tablet or desktop computer.

Requirements

You have a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or similar, and a minimum 4 years of professional experience within enterprise web development and cloud services.
You are participating in a team of talented developers constantly driving the product forward, while also keeping a vigilant eye on the technical debt, the feedback from our production system and the procedures surrounding the development process.
You are eager to continuously learn and improve, you listen with the intent to understand
You have a positive and constructive approach, bringing a smile and positive vibes with you
Most importantly, you care about your team, and care about having an enjoyable working environment

Relevant knowledge and experience in the following is valued:

Designing and building solutions on cloud-architectures (experience with Azure is preferred)
Experience with JavaScript frameworks and web APIs (experience with Angular, TypeScript, C# .NET Core is preferred)
Writing testable code, testing your own work, reviewing others work and providing helpful feedback to your team
Knowledge and familiarity with approaches such as Agile, Lean, XP and practices including but not limited to Test-Driven Development, Pair Programming, Mob Programming, Specification By Example
Practical experience with SimCorp Portfolio, including day-to-day usage and support of the platform.

Job responsibilities

You will be part of an agile software development team specializing in modern web development and working closely with external stakeholders, as well as site reliability engineering team. You will be expected to iteratively deliver value to our clients, using good engineering practices – with your team, as a team. This means building scalable and highly available systems to be used by thousands of users simultaneously from all over the globe. The team is truly diverse in many aspects, and similar to the product, the team is also young, dynamic and innovative.

What we offer

Empowering Projects:
With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As a team, we engineer digital products that positively impact people’s lives.

Empowering Growth:
We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Our dedication is to provide timely and comprehensive assistance for every consultant through our dedicated Learning & Development team, ensuring their continuous growth and success.

DE&I Matters:
At GlobalLogic, we deeply value and embrace diversity
. We are dedicated to providing equal
opportunities for all individuals, fostering an inclusive
and empowering work environment.

Career Development:
Our corporate culture places a strong emphasis on career development, offering abundant opportunities for growth. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm.

Comprehensive Benefits:
In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment.

Flexible Opportunities:
At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company.

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

jobs.description:
We are TecAlliance — founded by more than 30 automotive aftermarket companies as a neutral Data‑as‑a‑Service market connector, serving as the neutral data terrain that interconnects them. With over 1,000 employees worldwide and customers in 140 countries, we enable the market — we never compete with it.

Join us in our Tenerife office as a Software Developer (m/f/d) to create and enhance technology solutions that support the company’s strategic goals and evolving business needs. Through the delivery of effective and sustainable software products, you will directly contribute to improving user experience, increasing productivity, and enabling business growth.

This is a full time position with 40 hours of work per week. You'll be working at our Santa Cruz de Tenerife office at least 1-2 days per week, while working the other days remotely, in agreement with your team.

Main Tasks:

Develop and maintain software solutions and components.
Analyze business and technical requirements.
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
Test and debug software solutions.
Resolve software defects and technical issues.
Participate in code reviews and team collaboration.
Support system performance and reliability improvements.
Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation initiatives.

Requirements:

Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent vocational training or practical experience.
Experience in software development within Agile environments.
Experience designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software solutions and components.
Exposure to working with modern development tools, version control systems, and software design principles.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional and international teams.
Experience solving technical challenges and delivering scalable, reliable software products.
Fluent English language skills (B2 level or higher) are mandatory, Spanish language would be a plus.

Technical Skills:

About 5 years of hands-on software development and coding experience.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with AWS, including developing, deploying, and/or operating cloud-based applications and services.
Strong proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages/frameworks: C#, Java, Go, Python, or Angular. Experience with additional languages or frameworks is an advantage but can be developed on the job.
Strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
Solid understanding of software development principles, methodologies, and best practices.
Good understanding of software design, architecture, and design patterns.
Experience with version control systems, particularly Git.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Practical experience working in Agile development environments.
Knowledge of software testing, automated testing, and code quality practices.
Experience applying good engineering practices to build maintainable, scalable, and reliable software solutions.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
jobs.description:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. 

Based in the beautiful city of Porto, you’ll be part of our collaborative Engineering & Development teams, working closely with your peers and decision-makers to maintain and develop our global services and products. 

As an SDET L1, you are a developer with a passion for quality. You won't just find bugs; you will build the tools and systems to prevent them. You will design and implement the custom testing tools and test cases required to validate new features before they ever hit production.

You will be an integral part of the development cycle, responsible for white-box testing and code reviews, aiming to improve the codebase and ensure seamless production releases.

Working within an agile team, you’ll encounter exciting technical challenges and a culture where you’ll always have your voice heard. You'll be working with colleagues from around the world, in a truly worldwide company. If you're passionate about learning and take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, we'd love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Full-Stack Testing:
Write and execute test cases (unit, integration, and stress tests) ensuring backend and frontend components are production-ready.

White-Box Exploration:
Dive into the application code to understand how features work under the hood, allowing you to design more effective tests.

Tooling & Innovation:
Develop and evolve internal tools and utilities needed to test complex new features or code changes.

Automation Development:
Write and maintain automated test scripts to cover new features, helping us move away from manual verification.

Debug & Investigate:
Identify the root cause of failures by analyzing logs and stack traces, reporting bugs with high-quality technical detail.

Feature Collaboration:
Participate in Scrum ceremonies, asking the "what if" questions during refinement to help the team spot edge cases early.

Testbed Support:
Assist in maintaining our testing environments.

Code Quality:
Participate in code reviews to ensure changes are maintainable and that error handling is robust.

Continuous Learning:
Work closely with Senior SDETs and Developers to learn how to architect scalable test suites and manage CI/CD pipelines.

WHO YOU ARE

The Foundation:
You hold a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or have a similar technical background. You have a solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and modern software architecture.

Technical Curiosity:
You are a natural problem-solver who enjoys deconstructing complex systems to see how they work (and how they might break).

The "Puzzle Solver" Mindset:
You aren't satisfied with knowing that something broke; you have the technical curiosity to find out why it broke and how to prevent it from happening again.

Agile Mindset:
You thrive in a collaborative environment. You understand that "Agile" isn't just a set of meetings, but a mindset of continuous improvement, flexibility, and delivering value in iterative cycles.

Language Agnostic:
While we primarily use .NET/C#
(and knowing it well is a major plus!), we value core engineering principles above all. If you are proficient in another language (like Java, Python, or C++) and are eager to learn our stack, we want to hear from you.

Scripting Skills:
You are comfortable working in a terminal and have experience with (or a strong interest in) scripting languages like PowerShell or Bash to automate repetitive tasks.

Git Fluent:
You are comfortable with version control (Git) and understand the workflow of branches and pull requests.

Great Communicator:
You have strong conversational English skills (written and spoken) and enjoy working in a multicultural environment.

Quality Advocate:
You believe quality is a collective responsibility and hold yourself and your teammates to a high standard when it comes to clean, maintainable code.

Previous experience i
n a Software Developer or QA Engineer role (including internships or significant academic projects) is considered an advantage.

Samba is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.  We strive to empower connection with one another, reflect the communities we serve, and tackle meaningful projects that make a real impact.
